mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) may potentiate sympathomimetic effects and phenelzine can inhibit monoamine oxidase affecting metabolism; dapagliflozin carries inherent DKA risk which may be exacerbated by metabolic stress from MAOI use.
action: Monitor for signs of diabetic ketoacidosis, maintain careful glucose monitoring, and consider alternative antidepressant if possible; if combination necessary, ensure adequate hydration and renal function monitoring.
